name: Insect Analysis Report
summary: The Insect Analysis Report carries urgent findings about a spreading threat in Tanaris. Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser has it copied so the warning can reach others.

sections.title: A Warning from Tanaris
sections.body: In Gadgetzan, Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser asks that the report be shared widely. Alchemist Pestlezugg believes everyone who can read should know of the danger. Fizzledowser agrees to make a copy for you to carry to your allegiance.

sections.title: The Scholar in the Drag
sections.body: In Orgrimmar, Zilzibin Drumlore studies Azeroth's life forms and history. He recognizes the creatures described in the report as silithid, and warns that they could consume the Tanaris desert rapidly. He calls them tools of a threat facing both Horde and Alliance.

faq.q: What is the Insect Analysis Report?
faq.answer: The Insect Analysis Report describes the silithid, a grave threat spreading from Tanaris.
Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan prepared the report, and Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser copies it for wider distribution.

faq.q: Why does Fizzledowser make a copy?
faq.answer: Alchemist Pestlezugg asks for a copy so the warning can be distributed among your allegiance.
Zilzibin Drumlore is a troll scholar in Orgrimmar who studies Azeroth's life forms and history.

faq.q: What creatures does the report describe?
faq.answer: Zilzibin identifies the creatures in the report as silithid, which threaten Tanaris and both the Horde and Alliance.

angles.text: The report is meant to warn your allegiance about the silithid, a threat Zilzibin Drumlore says faces both Horde and Alliance.
The report's warning concerns the silithid, which Zilzibin Drumlore identifies as a threat to both Alliance and Horde.
